entries.zh: 借助炮火掩护潜入城镇

entries.en: Get to the top of the manor house and pick up the sniper rifle
entries.zh: 前往庄园宅邸顶楼，拿起狙击步枪
消灭喷烟者火箭炮炮组

entries.en: Hold off the German counter attack
Go downstairs and stop the enemy breaking in
Find cover before taking more damage
entries.zh: 寻找掩护，避免继续受伤

entries.en: Press and hold     to use ADS
Press     to throw a smoke grenade
Release      to throw a frag grenade
entries.zh: 松开  投掷破片手榴弹

entries.en: Hold     to cook a frag grenade
entries.zh: 按住  拉开手榴弹保险并延时投掷

entries.en: Press     to mantle over the obstacle
Press    to fire the tank's cannon
Press    to fire the tank's machine gun
Press and hold    to use the tank's ADS
entries.zh: 按住  使用坦克瞄准镜

entries.en: Your compass is on the bottom-left of the screen
entries.zh: 指南针位于屏幕左下角

entries.en: Your Objective markers are displayed on here, marked by a golden star
entries.zh: 任务目标会以金色星标显示在指南针上

entries.en: Head toward these to progress to your current objective
entries.zh: 朝着星标前进，抵达当前任务目标

entries.en: Remember, press    to ADS and press    to shoot
entries.zh: 记住，按  举枪瞄准，按  射击

entries.en: If you are getting damaged, find a safe place to hide until your health increases
entries.zh: 受到攻击时，找个安全的地方躲好，等待生命值恢复

entries.en: Stay out of the way when a flamethrower is firing
entries.zh: 火焰喷射器开火时，远离喷射方向

entries.en: Press    to bring up a list of your current objectives
entries.zh: 按  查看当前任务目标列表

entries.en: When an objective is greyed out, it means it has already been completed
entries.zh: 目标变为灰色表示已经完成

entries.en: Your Driver will control the Sherman and take you to Bastogne.
entries.zh: 驾驶员会操纵谢尔曼坦克，带你前往巴斯托涅。
